$comment: Recettas recipe export template. Ingredients reference foods by name/brand/unit instead of DB uuids so they can be re-matched in a new project. Omit id/user_id/created_at on import.

field_notes.name: text, required
field_notes.image: text URL (not a storage path), nullable
field_notes.yield_amount: number > 0, weight in g of finished dish; null = sum of ingredients
field_notes.ingredients[].amount: number > 0, in the food's base_unit (ml counted as g)
field_notes.ingredients[].sort_order: int, display order; one entry per food per recipe
field_notes.ingredients[].food: natural key to re-match in public.foods (name + brand); base_amount/base_unit default 100 / 'g'
field_notes.sections: ordered, free-form list of {title, items[]} (stored as jsonb)
